evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Elizabeth most of our customers have two concerns. One, the movers not being on time or two damage to their property and items when being moved, or any of these a concern for you.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'No I think they'll do a good job' — no concerns raised, so N/A.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Never addressed. Rep did not discuss cheaper days or date flexibility savings.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep never asked for the business. Instead: 'I'm gonna send this email right now and then if you do have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.' This is a soft hand-off with no explicit ask.

top_strength: Brianne delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full terms, and gathered comprehensive logistics details before quoting, giving a personalized range based on actual move size.
coaching_note: You must ask for the business explicitly ("Would you like our help with your move?") before sending the email — the customer booked via the system but you never closed the loop with a direct ask, and you skipped the rate lock/no deposit framing that makes saying yes easy.
